ev.q: Evidence from 13 studies evaluating the association between progestin-only injectable contraceptives and risk for HIV acquisition suggested a possible increased risk
adjusted hazard ratio = 1.4 [95% confidence interval = 1.2–1.6] among 10 studies specifically examining DMPA
CDC adopted the updated WHO guidance for inclusion in the U.S. MEC guidance.
A systematic review of published evidence regarding the use of hormonal contraception and the risk for HIV acquisition was published in 2016
